title: 'Your gym changed your workout plan' leads nowhere if the member once deleted that plan's folder
what: When a trainer changes a workout plan, the member's phone gets the pop-up 'Your gym changed your workout plan. Tap to see it on the Workout tab.' If the member had deleted that plan's folder earlier, the phone skips the plan for good, even its new version. The tap opens the Workout tab and nothing new is there. The trainer believes the member has the new plan; the member has no way to get it back short of erasing all data.
expected: A deleted plan's folder stays away until the trainer changes the plan; a new version comes back as a folder (or the member is offered it), so the pop-up never points at nothing.
how_often: every change to a plan whose folder the member deleted
fix_line: Bring a deleted plan back when its version changes, or offer it on the Workout tab

title: Tapping the new or changed workout plan pop-up can show the old plan for up to 10 minutes
what: The phone asks the gym for plans at most every 10 minutes, and only when the Workout tab opens. Tapping the 'New workout plan' or 'changed your workout plan' pop-up opens the Workout tab the normal way, so if the member opened that tab in the last 10 minutes the new plan is not there yet and the old one shows.
expected: Opening the Workout tab from a workout plan pop-up asks the gym again at once, so the plan the pop-up names is there.
how_often: when the pop-up comes within 10 minutes of opening the Workout tab
fix_line: Make the plan pop-up's tap ask the gym again straight away
